align.name: Align
align.description: Specify how the trigger should align with the tooltip

autoAlign.name: Auto Align
autoAlign.description: Experimental: Will attempt to automatically align the tooltip.

copyButtonDescription.name: Copy Button Description
copyButtonDescription.description: Specify the description for the Copy Button

copyText.name: Copy Text
copyText.description: Optional text to copy. If not specified, the children node's innerText will be used.

disabled.name: Disabled
disabled.description: Specify whether or not the CodeSnippet should be disabled

feedback.name: Feedback
feedback.description: Specify the string displayed when the snippet is copied

feedbackTimeout.name: Feedback Timeout
feedbackTimeout.description: Specify the time it takes for the feedback message to timeout

hideCopyButton.name: Hide Copy Button
hideCopyButton.description: Specify whether or not a copy button should be used/rendered.

maxCollapsedNumberOfRows.name: Max Collapsed Rows
maxCollapsedNumberOfRows.description: Specify the maximum number of rows to be shown when in collapsed view

maxExpandedNumberOfRows.name: Max Expanded Rows
maxExpandedNumberOfRows.description: Specify the maximum number of rows to be shown when in expanded view

minCollapsedNumberOfRows.name: Min Collapsed Rows
minCollapsedNumberOfRows.description: Specify the minimum number of rows to be shown when in collapsed view

minExpandedNumberOfRows.name: Min Expanded Rows
minExpandedNumberOfRows.description: Specify the minimum number of rows to be shown when in expanded view

showLessText.name: Show Less Text
showLessText.description: String displayed when the Code Snippet has been interacted with to show more lines

showMoreText.name: Show More Text
showMoreText.description: String displayed when the Code Snippet text is more than 15 lines

type.name: Type
type.description: Provide the type of Code Snippet

wrapText.name: Wrap Text
wrapText.description: Specify whether or not to wrap the text.
